Instructional/evaluation format for an AI task, where a model must predict a response to a simulated user query about appointment time.

The pattern "The user wants to [action]. [Action] is [result]. [Action] is [result]." establishes a structured, terse format typical of test prompts or system logs.

"Record completed." is a closing statement, likely signaling end of a simulated interaction or task description, suggesting the next token could be a period, newline, or a new prompt/label.
"Change the appointment to Monday.
Change the appointment to Monday.
Record complete." — "Record complete." functions as a final confirmation phrase, possibly part of a simulated database or form entry, with "Record recorded." suggesting a closing status message or a prompt about recording/ending.
"Record complete."</explanation>
